page_title: Introducing Devin, the first AI software engineer

summary.name: Devin
summary.one_liner: Devin is an AI software engineer from Cognition that plans and executes engineering tasks autonomously in a sandboxed environment with a shell, code editor, and browser.
keywords: ai that writes code end to end
use_cases: Resolving bugs in open source GitHub issues
Building and deploying simple web apps end to end
Fine-tuning a language model from a research repository
Delegating engineering tasks for later review
summary.what_it_does: Devin is presented as an autonomous AI teammate that can plan and carry out complex engineering tasks, with claims of long-term reasoning and recall of context across steps. It has access to a shell, code editor, and browser inside a sandboxed compute environment. It reports progress in real time, accepts feedback, and can work alongside a user on design choices. The page shows demo examples including building and deploying a Game of Life website to Netlify, fixing a sympy bug from SWE-bench, and setting up fine-tuning from a GitHub link. On SWE-bench, the page reports Devin resolving 13.86% of issues end-to-end on a random 25% subset, versus a prior state of the art of 1.96%.
notable: Scored 13.86% end-to-end on SWE-bench, unassisted, vs. prior state of the art of 1.96% (per the page)
Runs in a sandbox with shell, code editor, and browser
Reports progress in real time and accepts feedback during work
caveats: Currently in early access with a waitlist, as capacity ramps up
SWE-bench result based on a random 25% subset of the dataset; a more detailed technical report was promised but not yet published
Pricing not stated on the page
